newsitem.title: USA: Interactive Flight cuts exercise price.
newsitem.headline: Interactive Flight cuts exercise price.

text.p: Interactive Flight Technologies Inc said on Friday it had reduced the exercise price of its class B warrants to $7.50 a share and it plans to redeem the unexercised warrants on January 17, 1997, for $0.05 a warrant.
D.H Blair Investment Banking Corp. mailed redemption notices on Oct. 23, 1996 to the holders of the class B warrants.

Interactive Flight also will offer to reduce the exercise price of its Class A warrants to $7.50 a share prior to the redemption date, the company said. However, this exercise offer has not yet commenced.
